title: Roles negative record
description: An institution searched for AI-leadership roles whose public record did not yield a qualifying event. The negative record is a finding: without it, a reader cannot tell a firm that was searched and came up empty from one that was never searched. Human-gated, exactly like data/not_classified.json.

institution.description: Must match a name or alias in the population.

searched_on.description: Date the search was run, YYYY-MM-DD. This one IS the reviewer's calendar, and says so: it dates the LOOKING, not any evidence.

outcome.description: Same two outcomes as the stage appendix: nothing qualifying was ever found, or a filed event was withdrawn on review.

reason.description: Public text. It must stand alone without this repo's private notes.
